text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
GRAAAAAAAAAAAH!! 
LIKE I'D LET YOU BYYYYYY!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Such terrifying ferocity...! 
And every bit of it is aimed squarely at 
me—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Yet. This suffocating atmosphere... 
feels familiar.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(The presence of wild beasts. Creeping in, 
watching my every move...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Unseen and distant. Even so, 
poised with desperate resolve to face me 
head-on 
the moment any malice was shown—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(—I remember that feeling. So... 
I won't be swallowed up so easily!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I know for certain—I can break through! 
Haaaaaaaaaaah...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact! She has claimed the Double 
Tiara!! 
An undefeated Double Tiara triumph— 
a glorious feat unseen in 63 years...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Only the commentator's voice echoed 
through the quiet venue. 
An undefeated Double Tiara— 
Everyone held their breath at the historic 
feat achieved before their eyes.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact! She has captured the Double 
Tiara!! 
Following the Oka Sho, 
she displayed another magnificent late 
charge!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: —Congratulations, Tact.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations..." "Congratulations!" 
"It hurts to admit... but you were 
amazing."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... 
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because there were no cheers, it 
came through so clearly. 
Your sheer strength... your commanding 
presence.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
You really are a star. After seeing that, 
how could I not acknowledge it? But—

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
...The final jewel, the Shuka Sho. 
I'm not letting you have it... So you'd 
better be ready.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Likewise. 
I will run straight ahead—all the way to 
the finish.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa...! Tact is incredible! 
Man, this has gotta be trending all over 
social media right now!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, this person posted too! Let's 
see... 
'Nice to meet you! I was watching the race 
too! 
I'm officially a fan of Daring Tact!'"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...Ohh, a reply! 'Someday, somewhere, 
let's cheer together— 
for Daring Tact's races!'"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"We did it, Trainer! 
We've won the Double Tiara...!"

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"—Daring Tact! 
Congratulations on winning the Double 
Tiara!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah... thank you so very much!

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"No, really, it's incredible. 
It's been so long since I felt this 
uplifted!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"Well, with... the state of the world 
right now. 
Even though we can keep putting on the 
races we love, 
there's just so much weighing on our 
minds..."

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"Looking out at the empty stands, 
I can't help thinking how electric it 
usually is..."

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"I'm here because I love racing... 
so seeing the girls look a bit lonely out 
there, 
it honestly broke my heart..."

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"But seeing you charge ahead with such 
pure resolve, 
winning race after race... 
it gave me so much hope!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, but... I was only doing it 
for Hidaka's sake..."

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"It's not just Hidaka. 
I'm certain so many people... are seeing 
hope in you!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes, yes... hehe. 
The banner gave me so much strength. 
...Yes, I'll give it my all!"
choice_data_list: Everyone back home was thrilled, huh?

Everyone back home was thrilled, weren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! They were saying we should celebrate 
'double' 
because of the Double Tiara... 
coming up with all sorts of tricky puns."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe... If we manage 
to claim the Triple Tiara after this..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I will win that final crown. 
—I promise I will claim the Triple Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I know everyone will come at me 
with everything they have. 
Even so—I will not yield."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Will you train me again... 
so that I can be certain to win the Shuka 
Sho?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Up next is the summer training camp to 
hone her skills. 
If we train hard there, Daring Tact 
will become a whole tier stronger.
choice_data_list:
Let's give the summer training camp our 
all!

Let's give the summer training camp our 
all, too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, sir. 
I look forward to working with you!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There is neither doubt nor anxiety on 
Daring Tact's face. 
Nor is it mere confidence— 
what shines there is an absolute resolve 
to see it through.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One more win—and she achieves the Triple 
Tiara. 
Her name will be etched into history. 
And yet...
choice_data_list: ...I'm gonna step outside for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Closing the door behind me, I let out a 
deep breath. 
Before I knew it, my hands were trembling 
slightly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With everything happening in the world, 
that reality had felt 
a little distant, but... 
having secured the Double Tiara, it hit me 
full force.
choice_data_list: (The Triple Tiara is right before us...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A historic, legendary feat. 
It's Daring Tact's dream, and—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A title far too heavy for a rookie 
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I slap both cheeks with all my might. As 
Daring Tact's 
trainer, I need to grow stronger mentally 
too— 
starting with this summer training camp.
